info.name: GitScope GitHub Profile Analyzer API (Overhauled)
info.description: Professional API collection for GitScope backend profiles analyzer. Features POST analysis, GET listings with filters/pagination, GET database aggregated statistics, PUT manual caching bypass refreshes, and DELETE cached items.

request.description: Queries GitHub, aggregates stars, forks, follower ratio, activity score, account age, and organization count, then upserts the MySQL cache.

query.description: Number of profiles to retrieve per page (defaults to 10)
Search keyword matching username, name, or location (optional)
Sort column: username, name, public_repos, followers, following, total_stars, total_forks, repo_activity_score, analyzed_at (defaults to analyzed_at)
Sorting direction: asc or desc (defaults to desc)

request.description: Retrieves the paginated list of all GitHub profiles that have been analyzed and stored in the database.
Returns aggregated summary metrics from the cache database: total cached profiles, average followers count, most popular language, and the top followed cached developer.

variable.description: The GitHub username to fetch from DB

request.description: Retrieves the cached profile data and calculated insights from the database for a specific GitHub user.

variable.description: The GitHub username to force refresh

request.description: Clears node-cache items for this user, pulls fresh metrics from the GitHub API, and updates the database record.

variable.description: The GitHub username to delete from DB

request.description: Deletes the analyzed profile and its associated language statistics from the database.
Checks server health status and active MySQL database pool connectivity.
